onChange.script:
if origin in ('Binding', 'BindingWriteback'):
		load = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.custom.load))

		# Get resource recommendations (based on Server Sizing & Architecture Guide)
		self.custom.recommended = exchange.architecturebuilder.resources.serverSizing.getRecommendedResources(load)

		# Write 'load' values to session props
		self.session.custom.structure.configs[self.params.uuid]['config']['load'] = load
